classification: literature-inspired sparse-episode transfer; not a faithful CMOR catalogue-survey reproduction
purpose: Test whether the published three-dimensional meteor-shower wavelet core provides competitive sparse-stream discrimination on the exact frozen 128-event OrbitTrace episode benchmark.

references.title: A meteoroid stream survey using the Canadian Meteor Orbit Radar II: Identification of minor showers using a 3D wavelet transform
references.role: three-dimensional Mexican-hat wavelet family, Sun-centered radiant-speed coordinates, 4 degree angular probe, 10 percent speed probe, and four-probe truncation

references.title: A comparative study of radar and optical observations of meteor showers using SAAMER-OS and CAMS
references.authors: Bruzzone, Janches, Jenniskens, Weryk, and Hormaechea
references.role: evidence that the wavelet family is applicable to optical video-orbit data

benchmark.independent_corpus: exact frozen SonotaCo 2023 one-shot episode benchmark after source and 2025 result freeze
benchmark.calibration: identical bin-specific calibration negatives used by every existing comparator
metrics: pooled false-positive rate at alpha 0.05 and 0.01

fixed_method.angular_distance: great-circle separation on the radiant sphere
fixed_method.test_locations: each observed event's radiant and speed
fixed_method.episode_score: maximum leave-one-out wavelet coefficient across observed-event test locations
fixed_method.normalization: none; every episode contains exactly 128 events and empirical calibration is identical across methods

claim_boundary.allowed: published-core wavelet adaptation on the common sparse-episode task
prohibited: faithful reproduction of the Brown et al. global CMOR survey
proof that the CMOR method was beaten
historical OrbitTrace discovery by the wavelet or fixed4 detector
selection of a different scale after seeing SonotaCo 2025 results

freeze_rules.blind_interval: retain the existing 20-55 degree removal inherited by the frozen episode factories
freeze_rules.post_result_changes: no coordinate, kernel, scale, truncation, test-location, score, seed, episode, calibration, or metric changes
freeze_rules.reporting: report the result even if wavelet exceeds fixed4 or performs near chance
